entities.summary: Smilis, was a legendary ancient Greek sculptor, the contemporary of Daedalus, whose name was associated with the archaic cult figure at the Heraion of Samos. Smilis was born on the island of Aegina and his father was named Euclides. He was the legendary head of the Aeginetan School of sculpture. Smilis was a painters & sculptors from Aegina (b. 550 BCE, Aegina). Recognized as a landmark figure with global significance (referenced in 0 Wikipedia editions).
